Napoli head coach Massimiliano Allegri has been handed a two-game suspension by the Lega Serie A and will now be suspended for his upcoming matches against Monza and his former club Juventus. See the full list of suspensions after the eighth round of Serie A fixtures below.
Allegri and Gaspar given two-match bans after Serie A Week 8
The eighth round of 2026-27 Serie A fixtures began on Friday night with Torino’s 3-2 victory over Monza and came to a close with Milan’s 2-0 win away against Udinese on Sunday night.
Only one [layer was sent off during the weekend’s round of Serie A fixtures: Lecce’s Kiolonda Gaspar, who has earned a two-match suspension after being shown a straight red card after being sent off at the end of his side’s 2-0 defeat against Juventus on Sunday.
ITALY – OCTOBER 25: Kialonda Gaspar of US Lecce competes for the ball with Randal Kolo Muani of Juventus FC during the Serie A match between US Lecce and Juventus at Stadio Via del Mare on October 25, 2026 in Italy. (Photo by Maurizio Lagana/Getty Images)No players have yet reached the five yellow card threshold to earn a one-match ban, although Frosinone’s Gabriele Bracaglia and Cagliari’s Alessandro Deiola are now on four each.
The only other individual to earn a suspension this weekend was Napoli head coach Allegri, who was shown a red card for his protests after Leonardo Balerdi’s late equaliser in the 3-3 draw between the Partenopei and Roma on Saturday evening.
Allegri took off his jacket and stormed off after being shown a red card, but returned a few moments later and needed to be held back by members of his coaching staff.
His reaction has earned him a two-match ban, which means that he will not be permitted to sit in the dugout for Napoli’s next matches against Monza or away against Juventus next weekend.

בשל העונש, אלגרי לא יוכל לעמוד על הקווים במשחק הליגה הקרוב מול מונצה, וכן יחמיץ את משחק החוץ המסקרן נגד קבוצתו הקודמת, יובנטוס, בסוף השבוע הבא. מדובר במכה מקצועית משמעותית עבור נאפולי המנסה לשמור על יציבות בצמרת הליגה.
